title: What the Breath Carried

mood.label: Heavy going
mood.summary: Heavy going (36): COP31 collapsed after two days of overtime, Asian markets fell, and strikes, fighting, fire and storm took lives on several continents. Modest relief came from a blood-pressure drug and whale genomes sequenced from breath.

lines: They carried the talks two days past the end,
The word they had fought for was not on the page,
so Europe said no to it there.
Ukraine asks for shields while it buries its own,
smoke lies on the Hormuz tide,
Ebola workers take shelter from guns,
and the searchers go on where the fire has died.
But out on the water a whale came to breathe,
and a small drone caught what it gave —
a whole life written in one breath of air,
